constraints: The semantic type and all required parameters are resolved.
definition: Exactly one typed semantic value with qualifiers and no collection topology.
information_loss_risks: Carrier coercion may lose precision or semantic qualifiers.
invalid_operations: Collection operations are invalid.
name: scalar

constraints: Exactly one alternative is active.
Absent requires a governed reason; present may not carry an absence reason.
definition: A tagged sum of present typed value or an absence reason, never an unqualified null.
information_loss_risks: Collapsing reasons to null is lossy.
invalid_operations: Arithmetic on absent is invalid without an explicit lifting policy.
name: optional value

constraints: Tag is known or explicitly preserved as unsupported.
Payload validates against the active alternative.
definition: A discriminated union of named alternatives whose tag has stable identity across editions.
information_loss_risks: Unknown alternatives may be dropped by closed readers.
invalid_operations: Reading payload under a different tag is invalid.
name: tagged union

constraints: Arity and position types are fixed by the tuple edition.
definition: A fixed-arity ordered heterogeneous product of typed positions.
information_loss_risks: Position/name conversion can lose role semantics.
invalid_operations: Reordering positions without a schema transform is invalid.
name: tuple

constraints: Field identities are unique within the schema.
Required fields are present or carry typed absence.
definition: A fixed schema of named heterogeneous fields with stable field identities.
information_loss_risks: Unknown-field dropping and default insertion may be semantically lossy.
invalid_operations: Name-only rename is invalid without field identity mapping.
name: struct

constraints: Every element validates against the same element type.
definition: A finite ordered list whose elements share one resolved type.
information_loss_risks: Reordering or deduplication loses sequence information.
invalid_operations: Set-like deduplication is invalid if multiplicity/order matter.
name: homogeneous list

constraints: Element equality is decidable under the declared profile.
No two members are equal.
definition: A finite extensional collection of unique elements under declared semantic equality, with no order.
information_loss_risks: List binding may accidentally invent order; canonicalization may fail for unorderable elements.
invalid_operations: Order-sensitive operations are invalid; map must preserve or re-establish uniqueness.
name: set

constraints: Multiplicity is a non-negative count for each distinct element.
definition: A finite bag retaining element multiplicity but no semantic order.
information_loss_risks: Repeated-list representation may imply accidental order; set conversion loses multiplicity.
invalid_operations: Set conversion is lossy when multiplicity exceeds one.
name: multiset

constraints: Keys are unique under declared key equality.
Every key and value validates against its role type.
definition: A finite partial function from unique typed keys to typed values.
information_loss_risks: JSON binding coerces keys to strings; duplicate keys may be overwritten.
invalid_operations: Merge is invalid without a collision policy.
name: map

constraints: Declared length matches payload.
Any digest declares algorithm and canonical byte scope.
definition: A finite opaque octet sequence accompanied by media type, length and optional integrity digest.
information_loss_risks: Transcoding or line-ending normalization changes content digest and may lose representation details.
invalid_operations: Semantic parsing is invalid without a media type and supported decoder.
name: binary blob

constraints: Input decodes under a declared character encoding.
Normalization and line-ending policy are explicit.
definition: A Unicode text sequence with normalization, language, direction and line-ending profiles.
information_loss_risks: Normalization, transcoding and newline conversion change byte offsets/digests.
invalid_operations: Byte offsets cannot be reused after normalization without a mapping.
name: text document

constraints: Exactly one root exists.
Every non-root node has exactly one parent.
Node identity/path semantics are declared.
definition: A rooted ordered or partially ordered tree of typed nodes, attributes and values.
information_loss_risks: Flattening may lose hierarchy, sibling order, namespaces or mixed content.
invalid_operations: Flattening is invalid without a collision, order and mixed-content policy.
name: tree document

constraints: Namespace-expanded names are unique where required.
Schema and canonicalization editions are explicit.
definition: A schema-bound document tree with namespaces, attributes, mixed content and lexical/canonical forms.
information_loss_risks: Prefix, entity, whitespace and lexical distinctions may be lost in canonical trees.
invalid_operations: Stringifying or object-mapping without mixed-content rules is invalid.
name: markup document

constraints: Schema identifier and edition resolve.
Unknown-field and presence policies are explicit.
definition: A finite structured message whose fields and compatibility behavior are governed by a schema edition.
information_loss_risks: Unknown fields, defaults, numeric widening and enum evolution may alter meaning.
invalid_operations: Schema evolution is invalid when semantic contracts change without a declared transform.
name: schema bound message

constraints: One grain is declared.
Each field has carrier and semantic type or an explicit unresolved gap.
definition: A named collection of fields representing one declared grain, without assuming relational key semantics.
information_loss_risks: Flattening nested values and dropping qualifiers may lose meaning.
invalid_operations: Treating row position as identity or grain is invalid.
name: record

constraints: Key validates and uniqueness scope is explicit.
definition: A record consisting of a typed key and value with explicit uniqueness or partition scope.
information_loss_risks: Partition hashes, serializers and null-key conventions can alter routing/meaning.
invalid_operations: Last-write-wins is invalid without a time/order/finality policy.
name: key value record

constraints: Entity identity, entity type, valid/as-of time and authority are present.
definition: A record asserting the state of one identified entity at a declared valid or as-of time.
information_loss_risks: Current-only storage loses history; field overwrite may hide corrections.
invalid_operations: Snapshot difference is not a domain event unless transition semantics are known.
name: entity snapshot

constraints: Version identity is immutable.
Predecessor relation is acyclic within an entity unless branching is explicitly supported.
definition: An immutable edition of entity state linked to entity identity, version identity and predecessor relation.
information_loss_risks: Squashing versions loses correction and authority history.
invalid_operations: Selecting latest is invalid without a branch, recorded-time and finality policy.
name: entity version

constraints: Participant roles satisfy relationship-type cardinalities.
Relationship identity/equality and temporal validity are explicit.
definition: A typed relationship assertion among identified participants with roles, validity and provenance.
information_loss_risks: Direction, role, multiplicity and temporal qualifiers may be lost across graph models.
invalid_operations: Binary-edge coercion is invalid for genuine n-ary relationships without a reification contract.
name: relationship record

constraints: Transaction identity and atomic boundary are explicit.
Debits/credits/effects satisfy the domain transaction invariant supplied by a vertical pack.
definition: An atomic business or system transaction assertion with participants, amounts/effects, authority and transaction boundary.
information_loss_risks: Flattening may lose atomic grouping, reversal links or authority.
invalid_operations: A transaction is not equivalent to an event envelope or arbitrary database commit.
name: transaction record

constraints: Command identity/idempotency key is explicit.
A command is not represented as a past-tense fact.
definition: A request to perform an action, carrying intent, target, issuer, idempotency and expected-state conditions.
information_loss_risks: Dropping expected-state or idempotency fields changes concurrency behavior.
invalid_operations: Treating command receipt as successful domain event is invalid.
name: command record

constraints: Event identity is unique within source.
Payload schema and content type resolve or remain explicitly unsupported.
definition: A portable envelope identifying an event occurrence, source, type, optional time, schema and payload.
information_loss_risks: Broker metadata and payload time may be conflated; extensions may be dropped.
invalid_operations: Envelope type does not prove domain-event semantics or ordering.
name: event envelope

constraints: Fact is immutable; corrections/retractions are new facts.
Event identity, event type and domain meaning are resolved.
definition: A past-tense immutable fact about a domain occurrence with subject, type, event time and authority.
information_loss_risks: Flattening may lose subject multiplicity, validity, authority or correction lineage.
invalid_operations: Silent overwrite and inferred total order are invalid.
name: domain event record

constraints: Event and observed timestamps remain distinct.
Resource and instrumentation scope are retained when present.
definition: An observed log/event record with event and observed timestamps, severity, body, resource and correlation identifiers.
information_loss_risks: Parsing free text may be partial; dropping resource/scope breaks correlation.
invalid_operations: Log order is not causal order; log text is not a structured event without a parser contract.
name: log record

constraints: Manifest paths/identities are unique.
Declared digests validate against exact payload bytes.
definition: A manifested collection of files/objects plus metadata, integrity digests and references.
information_loss_risks: Repackaging may change byte digests, paths or external reference availability.
invalid_operations: Digest success does not prove member semantics, authority or safety.
name: document bundle

constraints: Feature of interest, observed property, result and procedure/method are explicit.
Result semantic type matches the observed property contract.
definition: An assertion relating a feature of interest, observable property, procedure, result and phenomenon/result times.
information_loss_risks: Flattening may conflate sample with feature of interest or phenomenon with result time.
invalid_operations: Result alone must not be detached from property, unit, method, time or feature.
name: observation assertion

constraints: Quantity kind and unit are commensurable.
Procedure, feature/property and measurement quality are declared.
definition: An observation whose result is a measured quantity with unit, procedure, uncertainty and quality.
information_loss_risks: Dropping unit, uncertainty, calibration or sampling support makes results incomparable.
invalid_operations: Unit conversion across non-commensurable quantity kinds is invalid; averaging without scale/grain law is invalid.
name: measurement observation

constraints: Code system/scale edition resolves.
Ordinal versus nominal operation law is explicit.
definition: An observation whose result is a governed nominal or ordinal category.
information_loss_risks: Crosswalks may be many-to-many or context-dependent.
invalid_operations: Arithmetic on codes or nominal rank comparison is invalid.
name: categorical observation

constraints: Sample identity, sampling procedure and relationship to feature/population are explicit.
definition: An observation made on a sample that relates to a distinct ultimate feature or population of interest.
information_loss_risks: Losing inclusion probabilities or sample-feature linkage invalidates population inference.
invalid_operations: Sample result must not be generalized to population without a valid design/inference contract.
name: sampled observation

constraints: Claim, supporting evidence, method and defeaters/limitations are linkable.
definition: An interpreted finding about a subject backed by observations, method, evidence and authority.
information_loss_risks: Flattening may lose argument, defeater, scope or revision status.
invalid_operations: Finding is not raw observation; authority is not truth.
name: finding assertion

constraints: Estimand, target population, method and uncertainty are explicit.
definition: An estimate of an estimand together with population, design, method and uncertainty representation.
information_loss_risks: Dropping design or uncertainty encourages invalid precision and comparability claims.
invalid_operations: Point estimates with different estimands/populations are not comparable.
name: estimate observation

constraints: Censoring kind, bound(s), inclusivity, value type and mechanism are explicit.
definition: An observation whose latent value is only known relative to one or two bounds and a censoring mechanism.
information_loss_risks: Naive imputation biases inference and destroys censoring likelihood.
invalid_operations: Replacing censored value with a bound, zero, midpoint or null is invalid without an analysis policy.
name: censored observation

constraints: Target and selector resolve or are explicitly unavailable.
Body and motivation semantics are declared.
definition: A body related to a target through motivation, selector, provenance and optional temporal validity.
information_loss_risks: Embedded annotations may invalidate byte offsets after target changes.
invalid_operations: Annotation does not mutate or prove the target by itself.
name: annotation

constraints: Every tuple has the heading's attributes and types.
Tuple equality and duplicate policy are explicit.
definition: A finite set of tuples over a heading of named typed attributes, with set semantics unless multiplicity is declared.
information_loss_risks: Bag/set conversion changes multiplicity; null equality and collation vary.
invalid_operations: Row order is not semantic; SQL bag behavior must not be assumed to be set behavior.
name: relation

constraints: Each candidate key is unique under declared equality and missingness rules.
Foreign keys reference declared target key editions.
definition: A relation with at least one declared candidate key and optional foreign-key constraints.
information_loss_risks: Key coercion/collation can merge distinct identities; foreign-key dropping loses integrity.
invalid_operations: Upsert is invalid without selecting one stable key and collision policy.
name: keyed relation

constraints: Column lengths agree.
One row grain and any key/ordering semantics are declared.
definition: A named rectangular collection of equal-length typed columns and rows with declared grain, key and order status.
information_loss_risks: Partition columns, row order, missingness reasons and nested values may be lost across formats.
invalid_operations: Physical file or row order is not semantic unless declared.
name: table

constraints: Axis labels and duplicate-label policy are explicit.
Row index is not assumed to be entity identity.
definition: An in-memory or logical table with labeled axes, potentially ordered rows and heterogeneous columns.
information_loss_risks: Index, categorical dictionaries and missing-value distinctions may be lost in table conversion.
invalid_operations: Implicit alignment on duplicate or incomparable labels is invalid without policy.
name: data frame

constraints: Keys and foreign keys validate.
Decomposition dependencies and transaction boundaries are explicit.
definition: A set of keyed relations connected by declared foreign keys and decomposition dependencies.
information_loss_risks: Denormalization can multiply rows or lose update dependencies.
invalid_operations: Joining all relations without cardinality and grain checks is invalid.
name: normalized relation set

constraints: One row grain is declared.
Every repeated/derived column has provenance and aggregation/join path.
definition: A denormalized table combining attributes or repeated measures at one declared row grain.
information_loss_risks: Denormalization may duplicate measures and obscure join/cardinality provenance.
invalid_operations: Assuming every column is independently additive is invalid.
name: wide record table

constraints: Fact grain, keys, measures and additivity scopes are explicit.
Dimension references resolve for applicable valid time.
definition: A table of observations or transactions at a declared fact grain with measure and dimension-key roles.
information_loss_risks: Late dimension binding, duplicate facts and hidden allocation can corrupt aggregates.
invalid_operations: Aggregating a non-additive measure across forbidden dimensions is invalid.
name: fact table

constraints: Member identity and hierarchy parent rules are explicit.
Slowly changing semantics are declared.
definition: A keyed table of descriptive attributes and hierarchies for analytical entities, optionally versioned over valid time.
information_loss_risks: Type-1 overwrites lose history; hierarchy changes alter aggregate comparability.
invalid_operations: Joining current dimension state to historical facts is invalid unless intended.
name: dimension table

constraints: Each dimension join is cardinality-safe at the fact grain.
Conformed dimensions have common identity and temporal semantics.
definition: A fact table connected to conformed dimension tables with declared join cardinalities and measure aggregation laws.
information_loss_risks: Bridge tables and temporal dimensions can multiply facts; conformance assumptions may be false.
invalid_operations: Many-to-many joins and mixed grains are invalid without allocation/bridge semantics.
name: star schema

constraints: Hierarchy paths are acyclic or explicitly recursive.
Join cardinality and valid-time alignment are declared.
definition: A fact-centered analytical schema whose dimension hierarchies are normalized into linked tables.
information_loss_risks: Path ambiguity and version drift can change rollups.
invalid_operations: Skipping hierarchy levels or joining across mismatched versions is invalid.
name: snowflake schema

constraints: Each observation is located by required dimension values.
Measure representation, attributes and sparsity policy are declared.
definition: A collection of observations indexed by a declared product of dimensions with measures and attributes.
information_loss_risks: Normalization/abbreviation, empty cells and multi-measure representation may be lost in conversion.
invalid_operations: Dense-cell assumptions and cross-dimension aggregation are invalid without support/additivity laws.
name: multidimensional cube

constraints: Data structure definition resolves.
Every required dimension/measure/attribute and integrity constraint is satisfied.
definition: A multidimensional cube specialized to published statistical observations, measures, attributes, code lists and reference periods.
information_loss_risks: Abbreviated/normalized conversion can lose attachment-level intent if performed incorrectly.
invalid_operations: Microdata inference and unofficial aggregation are invalid without disclosure/design rules.
name: statistical observation cube

constraints: Coordinate keys are unique.
Absent cell, structural zero and missing observation are distinguished.
definition: A multidimensional cube storing only populated coordinates with an explicit absent-cell/default semantic.
information_loss_risks: Densification may manufacture observations; coordinate reordering can alter canonical bytes.
invalid_operations: Filling absent cells with zero is invalid unless structural-zero law is declared.
name: sparse cube

constraints: Cell definitions are mutually exclusive/exhaustive as declared.
Margins and structural zeros are marked.
definition: A finite cross-classification of counts or weights over categorical dimensions with declared margins and population.
information_loss_risks: Disclosure suppression, weights and sampling design may be lost.
invalid_operations: Treating suppressed or structurally impossible cells as observed zero is invalid.
name: contingency table

constraints: Element type and length/bounds are declared.
Axis meaning and unit are explicit when analytical.
definition: A one-dimensional fixed- or variable-length ordered array over one element type and optional axis meaning.
information_loss_risks: Axis metadata and masks may be dropped in raw buffers.
invalid_operations: Dot/add operations are invalid for unequal axes, units or incompatible semantic elements.
name: vector

constraints: Rows have equal length.
Axis roles, order, units and element algebra are explicit.
definition: A rectangular two-dimensional array with declared row/column axes and element algebra.
information_loss_risks: Transpose/layout conversion may lose axis labels; numeric conversion may lose precision.
invalid_operations: Matrix multiplication is invalid when inner axes or semantic units do not align.
name: matrix

constraints: Rank, extent, axis order and element type are declared.
Every coordinate in extent has one element or a typed mask state.
definition: A dense N-dimensional rectangular array with ordered named or positional axes and homogeneous elements.
information_loss_risks: Axis metadata, masks, units, endianness and chunk order may be lost.
invalid_operations: Broadcasting is invalid when semantic axes are incompatible; reshape cannot silently change axis meaning.
name: dense tensor

constraints: Coordinates are in bounds and unique or a duplicate-combine rule exists.
Implicit entries have declared semantics.
definition: A sparse N-dimensional tensor represented by explicit coordinates and values plus an absent/default policy.
information_loss_risks: Duplicate combination, coordinate ordering and implicit-value semantics may change across formats.
invalid_operations: Assuming implicit zero is invalid when absence/missing differs from zero.
name: coordinate sparse tensor

constraints: Pointer arrays are monotone and bounded.
Indices satisfy sorted/duplicate profile and values align.
definition: A 2-D sparse matrix encoded by compressed row or column pointers, indices and values.
information_loss_risks: Conversion can reorder duplicates or combine them under an unintended algebra.
invalid_operations: Interpreting structural absence as semantic missing is invalid.
name: compressed sparse matrix

constraints: Axis names are unique within coordinate system.
Coordinate values align with axis extents and declared interpolation semantics.
definition: An N-dimensional array whose axes and coordinates carry stable names, units and semantic roles.
information_loss_risks: Raw tensor conversion loses axis identity, coordinate values, units and calendars.
invalid_operations: Positional alignment is invalid when labeled coordinates differ.
name: labeled array

constraints: Chunk coverage, overlap/gap policy and codec pipeline are declared.
Logical element order is independent of object listing order.
definition: An N-dimensional array partitioned into independently encoded chunks with a logical array distinct from storage layout.
information_loss_risks: Rechunking changes bytes and performance; lossy codecs may alter values.
invalid_operations: Treating chunk boundaries as semantic partitions is invalid.
name: chunked array
representation_bindings: Parquet row groups for tabular binding

constraints: Offsets/counts are monotone, in range and cover elements per profile.
Empty segment and missing segment are distinct.
definition: A collection of variable-length subarrays sharing an element type and an explicit parent/segment index.
information_loss_risks: Padding or flattening may lose segment identity and missingness.
invalid_operations: Rectangular padding is invalid without a mask/absence contract.
name: ragged array

constraints: Value and mask extents agree.
Mask states and propagation policy are declared.
definition: An array pairing each element position with a validity or typed-quality mask.
information_loss_risks: One-bit validity cannot preserve multiple absence/quality reasons.
invalid_operations: Dropping mask or treating all invalid states as zero is invalid.
name: masked array

constraints: Width, height, channel interpretation, sample precision and orientation are explicit.
Pixel index and physical/world coordinates are distinguished.
definition: A sampled 2-D spatial field with pixel axes, channel/color semantics, coordinate system and sampling support.
information_loss_risks: Resampling, color conversion, compression and orientation normalization can be lossy.
invalid_operations: Channel arithmetic, interpolation and color conversion require channel/color profiles.
name: image

constraints: Channel identity, order, unit, dynamic range and calibration are explicit.
definition: An image with one or more named channels, each with spectral/semantic meaning and optional calibration.
information_loss_risks: Channel reordering, scaling and display rendering may destroy quantitative values.
invalid_operations: Treating arbitrary channels as RGB or commensurable measures is invalid.
name: multichannel image

constraints: Label zero/background semantics and label vocabulary are explicit.
Interpolation is nearest/category-preserving only unless otherwise proven.
definition: An integer-valued image whose pixels/voxels denote governed region labels rather than numeric intensity.
information_loss_risks: Resampling can merge/split regions; dropping codebook loses meaning.
invalid_operations: Linear/cubic interpolation and numeric averaging of labels are invalid.
name: label image

constraints: Each level transform and extent relative to the intrinsic coordinate system are explicit.
Downsampling method and loss are recorded.
definition: A hierarchy of spatially aligned image levels at decreasing resolutions with declared transforms and downsampling provenance.
information_loss_risks: Lower resolutions are lossy and may not preserve labels, extrema or quantitative measurements.
invalid_operations: Pixel-wise comparison across levels without coordinate/scale alignment is invalid.
name: multiresolution image pyramid

constraints: Axis order, spacing, orientation, coordinate transforms and units are explicit.
definition: A sampled three-dimensional field over voxels with physical axes, spacing, orientation and optional channels/time.
information_loss_risks: Resampling/affine conversion can change resolution, orientation and quantitative values.
invalid_operations: Voxel index equality is not physical-position equality across coordinate systems.
name: voxel volume

constraints: Grid geometry, CRS, extent, resolution, cell interpretation and range fields are explicit.
definition: A 2-D or N-D grid of cells mapped to a spatial/temporal domain with cell support and range semantics.
information_loss_risks: Reprojection/resampling are generally lossy and nodata semantics can disappear.
invalid_operations: Point/area cell interpretation and nodata/zero must not be conflated.
name: raster

constraints: CRS, dimensionality, point identity/multiplicity and attribute schema are explicit.
definition: A finite or streamed set of points in a coordinate reference system with per-point attributes and optional acquisition order/time.
information_loss_risks: Downsampling and coordinate quantization are lossy; point identity may be unstable.
invalid_operations: Point order and density do not imply surfaces or trajectories.
name: point cloud

constraints: Vertex indices resolve.
Cell orientation, dimensionality, manifold/non-manifold policy and CRS are explicit.
definition: A set of vertices and incidence-defined cells/faces/edges embedded in a coordinate reference system.
information_loss_risks: Simplification/remeshing changes topology and interpolation support.
invalid_operations: Treating connectivity as incidental or reordering oriented cells without transform is invalid.
name: mesh

constraints: Domain set, range type, CRS, interpolation and nil/missing semantics are explicit.
definition: A function-like mapping from positions in a spatial/temporal domain to homogeneous range-field values.
information_loss_risks: Encoding and resampling may alter domain support, interpolation and nil reasons.
invalid_operations: Assuming values between samples without interpolation semantics is invalid.
name: coverage

constraints: Grid limits, axes, offsets/transforms, CRS and range fields are explicit.
definition: A coverage whose domain is a regular, irregular or transformed multidimensional grid.
information_loss_risks: Axis/order/transformation metadata loss makes the array spatially uninterpretable.
invalid_operations: Array index is not world coordinate without grid transform.
name: grid coverage

constraints: Order key and tie/duplicate policy are explicit.
definition: A sequence of typed observations ordered by a declared semantic coordinate or sequence key.
information_loss_risks: Sorting, deduplication and coordinate coercion may alter order/ties.
invalid_operations: File order is not a semantic order unless declared.
name: ordered series

constraints: Time grid origin, cadence, calendar/time zone, duplicates and gap policy are explicit.
definition: A series sampled on a declared regular time grid with value semantics, cadence and gap policy.
information_loss_risks: Timezone/calendar conversion, resampling and missing-point filling can be lossy.
invalid_operations: Interpolation, fill-forward and aggregation are invalid without value-scale and gap semantics.
name: regular time series

constraints: Timestamp role, time scale, duplicates and non-monotonic arrivals are explicit.
definition: A series of timestamped values with non-uniform gaps and explicit duplicate/order/lateness policy.
information_loss_risks: Resampling and deduplication require value-specific policies.
invalid_operations: Assuming regular cadence or treating arrival order as time order is invalid.
name: irregular time series

constraints: Variable identity/unit and alignment grid are explicit.
Synchronous versus asynchronous sampling is declared.
definition: A time-indexed collection of multiple named value series with alignment, unit and missingness rules.
information_loss_risks: Wide conversion can manufacture simultaneity or nulls; alignment can interpolate implicitly.
invalid_operations: Position-wise arithmetic across unaligned timestamps or incompatible units is invalid.
name: multivariate time series

constraints: Unit identity, population, time role and balanced/unbalanced status are explicit.
definition: Repeated observations for multiple identified units across time, with declared balanced/unbalanced and entry/exit semantics.
information_loss_risks: Pivoting can hide attrition, duplicated units or time-varying attributes.
invalid_operations: Missing waves must not be treated as zero; changing population is not a balanced panel.
name: panel series

constraints: Cohort definition, subject identity, entry/exit/censoring and outcome semantics are explicit.
definition: A panel-like structure following a defined cohort with enrollment, censoring, outcomes and time-varying covariates.
information_loss_risks: De-identification/linkage changes may break longitudinal identity; windowing may induce bias.
invalid_operations: Loss to follow-up, competing events or censoring must not be encoded as ordinary missingness.
name: longitudinal cohort

constraints: Endpoint type, closure, overlap, adjacency and coalescing policy are explicit.
definition: A series of values, states or assertions attached to temporal intervals with closure and overlap semantics.
information_loss_risks: Endpoint precision conversion changes overlap; coalescing can lose provenance.
invalid_operations: Scalar sorting or coalescing adjacent intervals with unequal values/provenance is invalid.
name: interval series

constraints: Sampling rate/clock, start time, unit, quantization and gap/timing-quality semantics are explicit.
definition: A sequence of samples of a continuous or discrete phenomenon with clock, sample rate, unit and calibration.
information_loss_risks: Quantization, compression, filtering and resampling alter waveform and phase.
invalid_operations: Resampling without anti-aliasing and clock/gap handling is invalid.
name: sampled signal

constraints: Channel identities, rates, clock relation, synchronization and calibration are explicit.
definition: Multiple named sampled signals with channel identity, synchronization and per-channel calibration.
information_loss_risks: Channel mixing, time shift and resampling may be irreversible.
invalid_operations: Position-wise comparison across unsynchronized channels is invalid.
name: multichannel signal

constraints: Source signal, transform/window, overlap, scaling and phase retention are explicit.
definition: A time-frequency representation with window, transform, overlap, scaling and complex/magnitude semantics.
information_loss_risks: Magnitude-only or quantized representations are not generally invertible.
invalid_operations: Inverse transform is invalid if phase or required overlap/window information was discarded.
name: spectrogram

constraints: Time base, channel layout, sample format/codec and edit list are explicit.
definition: A timed sequence of audio samples/frames with channels, sample rate, codec and time reference.
information_loss_risks: Codec, resampling, mixing and edits can be lossy and change timing.
invalid_operations: Sample index is not wall-clock time without time reference; lossy transcode is not identity-preserving.
name: audio track

constraints: Time scale, decode/presentation order, frame geometry, color and codec configuration are explicit.
definition: A timed sequence of video samples/frames with decode/display timing, geometry, color and codec semantics.
information_loss_risks: Transcode, frame-rate conversion, cropping and color conversion are lossy.
invalid_operations: Decode order is not presentation order; frame number is not a universal timestamp.
name: video track

constraints: Track identities, timescales, edits, synchronization and references are valid.
definition: A container of synchronized timed tracks, metadata and edit/timeline relationships.
information_loss_risks: Remuxing may preserve samples but alter metadata/timing; transcoding changes samples.
invalid_operations: Concatenating tracks with incompatible time bases/codecs is invalid without a transform.
name: timed media container

constraints: Snapshot identities are immutable.
Order/branch and as-of meaning are explicit.
definition: An ordered sequence of collection snapshots with snapshot identity, as-of/recorded time and derivation relation.
information_loss_risks: Diffing may miss transient states or confuse rewrite with semantic change.
invalid_operations: Snapshot diff is not automatically a business change event.
name: snapshot sequence

constraints: Change kind, key, schema edition and per-key order are explicit.
Before/after pairing semantics are declared.
definition: A stream or finite log of row-level insert, update-before, update-after and delete changes with key/order semantics.
information_loss_risks: Upsert normalization drops before images; compaction may lose intermediate changes.
invalid_operations: Applying out of order or without key/schema compatibility is invalid.
name: row changelog

constraints: Source position, transaction boundary, schema edition and snapshot/change boundary are explicit.
definition: An ordered stream of source-record changes carrying operation, key, before/after images, source position and transaction context.
information_loss_risks: Schema changes, omitted before images and transaction fragmentation can impair replay.
invalid_operations: Cross-partition total order and exactly-once effect must not be inferred from delivery.
name: change data capture stream

constraints: Stable key, per-key order, duplicate policy and tombstone meaning are explicit.
definition: A keyed stream where each record replaces the current value for its key under explicit ordering and tombstone semantics.
information_loss_risks: Before images and intermediate versions are lost relative to a full changelog.
invalid_operations: Last-arrival-wins is invalid if arrival order differs from authoritative sequence.
name: upsert stream

constraints: Retraction target, authority, reason and scope resolve.
Retraction is preserved as a fact rather than physical deletion.
definition: A stream of assertions and explicit retractions/corrections linked to prior assertion identity.
information_loss_risks: Snapshot projection can hide contested/retracted history.
invalid_operations: Deleting the original without retraction evidence is invalid for auditable histories.
name: retraction stream

constraints: Watermark semantics, partition combination, allowed lateness and late-event policy are explicit.
definition: An unbounded event-time stream carrying watermark/frontier claims, lateness and update behavior.
information_loss_risks: Late-drop policies lose facts; partition-idle handling changes frontier.
invalid_operations: Watermark is not proof that no earlier event exists in the world; unbounded global sort is invalid.
name: watermarked event stream

constraints: Trace/span identifiers, parent/link roles, time bounds and resource/scope are explicit.
definition: A trace-correlated directed acyclic or general graph of spans, events and links with timing and resource context.
information_loss_risks: Sampling, dropped spans and clock skew make graph incomplete and timing uncertain.
invalid_operations: Parent/link relation is not sufficient evidence of business causality; clocks may be skewed.
name: trace span graph

constraints: Metric stream identity, point kind, unit, temporality and monotonicity are explicit.
definition: A family of ordered metric points identified by resource, scope, metric identity, attributes, unit and temporality.
information_loss_risks: Attribute removal/reaggregation, temporality conversion and histogram downscaling can be lossy.
invalid_operations: Merging streams with different identity/unit/temporality is invalid.
name: metric stream

constraints: Bucket boundary inclusivity/order, count, temporality and sum semantics are explicit.
definition: A metric stream whose points summarize a distribution into counts, bounds, sum and optional exemplars.
information_loss_risks: Bucket merging/downscaling and exemplar sampling lose distribution detail.
invalid_operations: Exact quantiles or raw sample recovery from finite buckets is invalid.
name: histogram stream

constraints: Case identity, event identity, activity, ordering/tie policy and lifecycle are explicit.
definition: A case-centric event log grouping ordered events into traces with activity and lifecycle semantics.
information_loss_risks: Flattening multi-object processes to one case may duplicate/drop relations and change behavior.
invalid_operations: Creating one case notion by guesswork or timestamp-only sorting is invalid.
name: case event log

constraints: Event/object types, identities and qualified relationships resolve.
Object attribute changes retain order and validity.
definition: An event log relating events to multiple typed objects and qualified object-object/event-object relationships.
information_loss_risks: Case projection can introduce convergence/divergence and lose n-ary relationships.
invalid_operations: Projection to a case log is invalid without object/case selection and duplication policy.
name: object centric event log

constraints: Activity instance identity and legal lifecycle transition system are explicit.
definition: An event log representing activity lifecycle transitions such as schedule, start, suspend, resume and complete.
information_loss_risks: Missing events and clock skew bias duration/waiting estimates.
invalid_operations: Inferring start/complete pairs from names or timestamps without lifecycle semantics is invalid.
name: activity lifecycle log

constraints: Actor/authority, action, target, outcome, time and integrity evidence are present.
definition: An append-preserving sequence of who did what to which governed object, when, under which authority and outcome.
information_loss_risks: Sampling, redaction and broken identity resolution can make the trail incomplete.
invalid_operations: Overwriting/deleting prior entries or treating log existence as non-repudiation is invalid.
name: audit trail

constraints: Vertex/edge identity, endpoints, direction, loops and multiplicity policies are explicit.
definition: A collection of vertices and edges under declared identity, multiplicity, direction and attribute semantics.
information_loss_risks: Conversions may lose parallel edges, labels, direction or attributes.
invalid_operations: Graph algorithm preconditions must not be inferred from generic graph shape.
name: graph

constraints: Every edge source/target resolves; loop and parallel-edge policies are explicit.
definition: A graph whose edges are ordered source-target pairs and may carry attributes.
information_loss_risks: Undirected conversion loses direction; simple-graph conversion may merge edges.
invalid_operations: Topological sort is invalid if cycles exist.
name: directed graph

constraints: Edge identity distinguishes parallel edges.
Multiplicity and loop semantics are explicit.
definition: A graph permitting multiple distinct edges between the same endpoint tuple.
information_loss_risks: Simple-graph conversion loses parallel-edge identity and attributes.
invalid_operations: Endpoint-pair deduplication is invalid unless edge merge algebra is declared.
name: multigraph

constraints: Graph is acyclic under declared edge subset and edition.
definition: A directed graph constrained to contain no directed cycles.
information_loss_risks: Cycle breaking or edge dropping changes dependency semantics.
invalid_operations: Adding an edge that creates a cycle is invalid.
name: directed acyclic graph

constraints: Exactly one root; each non-root has one parent; no cycles.
definition: A rooted connected acyclic graph in which every non-root node has exactly one parent.
information_loss_risks: Graph-to-tree projection may duplicate nodes and invent a root/path.
invalid_operations: Multi-parent relationships cannot be represented without duplication or graph generalization.
name: tree

constraints: Hyperedge membership roles, cardinalities, multiplicity and identity are explicit.
definition: A graph-like incidence structure whose hyperedges relate arbitrary finite sets or role-indexed tuples of vertices.
information_loss_risks: Projection to ordinary graph may create cliques/stars and lose role/edge identity.
invalid_operations: Binary-edge projection is invalid without loss declaration for n-ary relations.
name: hypergraph

constraints: Every vertex has exactly one partition type; every edge crosses partitions.
definition: A graph whose vertices are partitioned into two disjoint types and edges cross but do not stay within partitions.
information_loss_risks: One-mode projection loses original edge objects and may inflate connection weights.
invalid_operations: Within-partition edge insertion is invalid.
name: bipartite graph

constraints: Element identity, labels, property multiplicity/type and edge direction are explicit.
definition: A graph with identified vertices/edges, labels and typed key-value properties under a declared property-graph profile.
information_loss_risks: RDF conversion may reify edges or alter identity; null/list/property multiplicity can be lost.
invalid_operations: RDF entailment or global property uniqueness must not be assumed.
name: property graph

constraints: Subjects, predicates and objects are valid RDF terms under the selected RDF edition.
Graph/dataset and blank-node scope are explicit.
definition: A set of RDF triples with RDF term identity and optional named-graph/dataset structure.
information_loss_risks: Blank-node relabeling, datatype lexical normalization and named-graph handling affect comparison.
invalid_operations: Blank-node identifiers are not global identity; property-graph edge semantics must not be assumed.
name: rdf graph

constraints: Element identity persists or versions explicitly.
Time roles and snapshot/event interpretation are declared.
definition: A graph whose vertices, edges or properties vary over valid/event/recorded time under explicit interval or event semantics.
information_loss_risks: Snapshot projection loses evolution and may conflate absence with deletion.
invalid_operations: Collapsing time or selecting latest without branch/finality policy is invalid.
name: temporal graph

constraints: Feature identity is distinct from geometry identity.
Every geometry/position declares CRS and axis order.
definition: An identified real-world or conceptual feature with geometry/coverage properties, attributes and CRS-qualified spatial support.
information_loss_risks: CRS loss, geometry simplification and identifier remapping impair identity/spatial analysis.
invalid_operations: Equal geometry does not imply same feature; geometry change does not necessarily mean new feature identity.
name: spatial feature

constraints: Geometry type, CRS, dimensionality, axis order and validity are explicit.
definition: A CRS-qualified geometric object such as point, curve, surface or collection with dimensionality and validity rules.
information_loss_risks: Reprojection, simplification, precision reduction and antimeridian handling can alter topology.
invalid_operations: Coordinate arithmetic across CRSs and topology operations on invalid geometry are invalid.
name: geometry

constraints: Feature identities are unique within scope.
CRS/schema heterogeneity policy and collection extent semantics are explicit.
definition: A collection of spatial features sharing or declaring schemas, CRS policy, extent and feature identity scope.
information_loss_risks: Reprojection and schema union may lose precision or properties; bounding extents may be approximate.
invalid_operations: Assuming one CRS/schema or file order is invalid unless declared.
name: feature collection

constraints: Object identity, CRS, time scale, sample order and interpolation semantics are explicit.
definition: An ordered sequence or continuous interpolation of positions for one moving object over time.
information_loss_risks: Map matching, smoothing and resampling alter path and uncertainty.
invalid_operations: Connecting samples or computing speed is invalid without time/CRS/interpolation/gap policies.
name: trajectory

constraints: Feature identity persists across temporal observations.
Geometry evolution and attribute validity semantics are explicit.
definition: A feature whose geometry and/or attributes vary over time with trajectories or temporal snapshots.
information_loss_risks: Snapshot projection and interpolation can erase motion uncertainty and discontinuities.
invalid_operations: Latest geometry is not valid for historical events without valid-time alignment.
name: moving feature

constraints: Graph topology and geometric embedding are both valid.
Costs/restrictions declare direction, units and effective time.
definition: A directed or undirected graph embedded in space with edge geometry, costs, restrictions and topology.
information_loss_risks: Simplification/snapping can create or remove connectivity; weight aggregation changes routes.
invalid_operations: Geometric intersection does not imply graph connectivity; stale restrictions must not be ignored.
name: spatial network

constraints: Bounds share compatible semantics and lower does not exceed upper under declared order.
Interval interpretation and coverage are explicit.
definition: A value represented by lower/upper bounds, closure and interpretation such as tolerance, censoring or uncertainty.
information_loss_risks: Open/closed endpoints, dependence and interpretation may be lost.
invalid_operations: Replacing interval by midpoint or endpoint is invalid without loss declaration.
name: interval valued data

constraints: Support, measure type, parameterization and normalization are valid.
Conditioning and estimand semantics are explicit.
definition: A probability measure represented by a named family/parameters, mass/density function or finite support.
information_loss_risks: Parametric approximation, discretization and truncation may lose tails/dependence.
invalid_operations: Comparing, adding or mixing distributions is invalid without compatible variables and dependence semantics.
name: probability distribution

constraints: Sampling origin/design, weights, dependence and replacement policy are explicit.
definition: A finite collection of sampled values with population/distribution origin, weights and dependence metadata.
information_loss_risks: Subsampling, deduplication and weight loss alter empirical distribution.
invalid_operations: Treating dependent/weighted samples as iid/unweighted is invalid.
name: empirical sample

constraints: Member identity, generation mechanism, weights and exchangeability/order semantics are explicit.
definition: A finite collection of comparable members or runs representing uncertainty, alternatives or replicated computations.
information_loss_risks: Member thinning, weighting loss and aggregation hide multimodality/dependence.
invalid_operations: Equal weighting or iid interpretation is invalid unless declared.
name: ensemble

constraints: Each scenario is internally coherent and identifies assumptions/parameter overrides.
Probability, weight and stress labels are distinguished.
definition: A governed set of coherent assumption or shock configurations with identifiers, provenance, weights/likelihood status and horizons.
information_loss_risks: Scenario reduction, parameter omission and reweighting alter coverage.
invalid_operations: Treating stress scenarios as probabilities or averaging incompatible horizons is invalid.
name: scenario set

constraints: Branch weights follow the declared probability/weight algebra.
Information availability and non-anticipativity groups are explicit.
definition: A rooted branching structure of staged uncertainty realizations with node probabilities/weights and information sets.
information_loss_risks: Scenario reduction changes tails and non-anticipativity structure.
invalid_operations: Using future branch information in earlier decisions is invalid.
name: scenario tree

constraints: Matrix is symmetric and positive semidefinite within tolerance.
Variable order, units and estimator are explicit.
definition: A symmetric matrix of pairwise covariances for an ordered vector of typed random quantities.
information_loss_risks: Rounding may break positive semidefiniteness; diagonal-only conversion loses dependence.
invalid_operations: Reordering without variable mapping or dropping off-diagonals is invalid.
name: covariance matrix

constraints: Parameter identity/transform, chain and draw indices, weights and warmup status are explicit.
definition: A collection of draws from an asserted posterior or approximation, retaining chain/draw identity and diagnostics.
information_loss_risks: Thinning, reshaping and dropping diagnostics can conceal non-convergence/dependence.
invalid_operations: Treating warmup, weighted or autocorrelated draws as iid is invalid.
name: posterior draws

constraints: Target, origin, horizon/valid time, conditioning data and uncertainty representation are explicit.
definition: A forecast distribution, quantiles or ensemble indexed by target, origin, horizon and valid time.
information_loss_risks: Quantile interpolation, ensemble reduction and late actual revisions affect evaluation.
invalid_operations: Mixing origins/horizons or treating quantiles as a coherent distribution without checks is invalid.
name: probabilistic forecast

constraints: Every variable domain, objective sense, constraint relation and unit is valid.
Feasibility and solution-status semantics are declared.
definition: A typed mathematical decision problem with variables, domains, objectives, constraints, parameters and solution semantics.
information_loss_risks: Linearization, scaling, relaxation and unsupported-feature dropping change the problem.
invalid_operations: Solving with unsupported constructs or silent reformulation is invalid.
name: optimization model

constraints: All expressions are affine and variable domains are continuous intervals.
Coefficient units are dimensionally consistent.
definition: An optimization model with linear objectives and constraints over continuous variables.
information_loss_risks: Scaling and finite-bound substitutions affect numerics; format limits may lose names/precision.
invalid_operations: Integer/discrete semantics and nonlinear terms are invalid.
name: linear program

constraints: Every discrete domain and integrality tolerance is explicit.
Objective/constraint expressions match the claimed class.
definition: A linear or supported nonlinear optimization model containing integer, binary or semi-discrete variable domains.
information_loss_risks: Reformulation, big-M choices, tolerances and presolve may affect numerical/semantic guarantees.
invalid_operations: Relaxing integrality without declaring a relaxation is invalid.
name: mixed integer program

constraints: Function domains, smoothness/convexity claims and derivative contracts are explicit.
definition: An optimization model with differentiable or non-differentiable nonlinear expression graphs and declared domains.
information_loss_risks: Approximations, differentiation, scaling and local/global solver differences affect guarantees.
invalid_operations: Assuming global optimality from local solver status or evaluating outside function domains is invalid.
name: nonlinear program

constraints: Variable domains and every global/local constraint semantic are explicit.
definition: A finite-domain or mixed-domain constraint satisfaction/optimization problem with variables, constraints and propagation semantics.
information_loss_risks: Decomposition and propagation-strength changes affect performance and sometimes numerical semantics.
invalid_operations: Replacing a global constraint by a weaker decomposition without declaration is invalid.
name: constraint problem

constraints: Network direction, cost/time units, demand, capacity and feasibility constraints are explicit.
definition: A graph-based routing decision problem with vehicles/commodities, demands, capacities, costs, time and service constraints.
information_loss_risks: Travel-time aggregation, map simplification and heuristic solution may lack proof.
invalid_operations: Shortest path is not a complete routing solution when capacities/time/service constraints exist.
name: routing instance

constraints: Duration/calendar, resource capacity, precedence and preemption semantics are explicit.
definition: A scheduling problem with jobs, activities, resources, precedence, calendars, durations and objectives.
information_loss_risks: Time discretization and calendar approximation may change feasibility.
invalid_operations: Calendar time and elapsed duration or precedence and mere list order must not be conflated.
name: scheduling instance

constraints: Flow conservation, units, capacity and gain/loss semantics are explicit.
definition: A directed network with supply/demand, capacities, gains/losses and cost for flow decisions.
information_loss_risks: Aggregation may hide capacity bottlenecks or unit conversion losses.
invalid_operations: Conservation cannot be assumed when gains, losses, storage or conversion exist.
name: network flow instance

constraints: Model edition and all assignment/objective/status conventions resolve.
Feasibility is checked independently under declared tolerances.
definition: A candidate solution with variable assignments, objective values, feasibility residuals, status, bounds and provenance.
information_loss_risks: Rounding or omitted variables may make a reported solution infeasible.
invalid_operations: Solver status alone is not an independently verified feasibility/optimality proof.
name: optimization solution

constraints: Certificate kind, model edition, numeric exactness/tolerance and checker contract are explicit.
definition: Evidence supporting infeasibility, unboundedness, dual bound or optimality under a mathematical problem class.
information_loss_risks: Floating-point certificates and unrecorded presolve transforms may not be independently checkable.
invalid_operations: Certificate must not be accepted for a transformed/different model without a checked mapping.
name: optimization certificate

constraints: State, parameters, inputs/outputs, time semantics, events and solver requirements are explicit.
definition: An executable or declarative dynamical/discrete-event model with variables, state, parameters, clocks and interface semantics.
information_loss_risks: Solver choice, tolerances, co-simulation coupling and external code affect results.
invalid_operations: Executing under unsupported solver/time semantics or hidden external state is invalid.
name: simulation model

constraints: Model, data, algorithm, configuration, horizon, seed/stream and output requests are versioned.
definition: A reproducible specification binding model edition, parameter changes, tasks, algorithms, horizons, seeds and requested outputs.
information_loss_risks: Unpinned dependencies, nondeterministic parallelism and solver changes alter results.
invalid_operations: Reusing a seed without generator/stream/parallelization policy is not full reproducibility.
name: simulation experiment

constraints: Event times are not earlier than permitted model time.
Tie-break and cancellation identity are deterministic under profile.
definition: A priority-ordered collection of future simulation events with time, tie-breaking and cancellation identity.
information_loss_risks: Serialization may lose exact priority/tie state or external callbacks.
invalid_operations: Wall-clock order or unstable heap order must not determine semantics.
name: discrete event calendar

constraints: Model/runtime editions, simulation time, random streams, pending events and external-state references are captured or declared non-restorable.
definition: A checkpointable snapshot of all model state needed to resume a simulation under a declared runtime contract.
information_loss_risks: External resources, thread scheduling and unsupported opaque state may prevent bitwise replay.
invalid_operations: Restoring under a different model/runtime or without hidden state is invalid.
name: simulation state

constraints: Run/model/configuration identity and output sampling/event policy are explicit.
definition: An ordered record of simulation state/output/events over model time with run identity and configuration provenance.
information_loss_risks: Output sampling, compression and truncation lose transient dynamics.
invalid_operations: A sampled trace cannot reconstruct unrecorded internal events/states without model guarantees.
name: simulation trace

constraints: Every member resolves to the same comparable output contract or a declared transform.
Scenario, seed and replicate roles are distinct.
definition: A collection of comparable simulation runs indexed by scenario, replicate, seed and configuration.
information_loss_risks: Aggregation can hide instability, failures and multimodal outcomes.
invalid_operations: Pooling different configurations or treating scenario runs as iid replicates is invalid.
name: simulation ensemble result

constraints: Operator identity, arity, operand types, binding scope and partiality are explicit.
definition: An abstract syntax tree for a typed formula with named operators, literals, references and source locations.
information_loss_risks: Pretty-print/parse round trips may lose comments/source locations; algebraic rewrites may change floating behavior.
invalid_operations: Evaluation is invalid with unresolved names/types or violated operator preconditions.
name: formula ast

constraints: Graph is acyclic; every operator input edge is typed and ordered where non-commutative.
definition: A typed directed acyclic graph sharing common expression subterms and preserving operator dependencies.
information_loss_risks: Floating evaluation order and common-subexpression rewrites can alter results.
invalid_operations: Tree expansion may duplicate stateful/expensive nodes; common-subexpression merging is invalid for effectful nodes.
name: expression dag

constraints: Every operator input/output schema, bag/set/null/time semantics and required properties are explicit.
definition: A provider-neutral typed relational/collection operator DAG with schemas, expressions, semantics and required properties.
information_loss_risks: Rewrite/lowering may change floating order, null/bag behavior, time or determinism.
invalid_operations: Provider lowering is invalid when it cannot preserve declared semantics.
name: logical query plan

constraints: Method, parameters, input/output semantics, transformations, population and software/configuration editions are explicit.
definition: An immutable classical statistical model artifact with input/output schema, parameters, transformations, method and evaluation provenance.
information_loss_risks: Serialization may omit software numerics, training design or unsupported model features.
invalid_operations: Applying outside declared input/population/time scope or with incompatible preprocessing is invalid.
name: statistical model artifact

constraints: Input/output semantics, method, reference standard, validity scope and uncertainty are explicit.
definition: A transformation or parameter set mapping raw measurements/scores to calibrated values under a declared scope and validity period.
information_loss_risks: Interpolation/extrapolation and coefficient rounding affect calibrated values.
invalid_operations: Applying outside instrument/population/range/time scope or double-calibrating is invalid.
name: calibration artifact

constraints: Every transform has input/output semantic types, fit state, time/grain and missingness behavior.
definition: A typed DAG of deterministic or stateful transformations from declared input fields to derived analytical features.
information_loss_risks: Provider implementations can differ in floating, category, missing and time behavior.
invalid_operations: Re-fitting, leakage across time/population or applying incompatible state is invalid.
name: feature transform graph

constraints: Evaluand, data/population, design, measures, uncertainty and limitations are explicit.
definition: A structured report linking model/artifact edition, evaluation design, population, metrics, uncertainty, failures and evidence.
information_loss_risks: Summary metrics hide subgroup, distribution, uncertainty and failure cases.
invalid_operations: Metric-only comparison across different populations/designs is invalid.
name: model evaluation report

constraints: Every referenced object identity, length/digest and schema/partition relation is explicit.
definition: An immutable inventory of dataset objects/files/partitions, schemas, digests, statistics, versions and provenance links.
information_loss_risks: External objects may disappear; statistics can be stale; rewrites change content identity.
invalid_operations: Manifest presence or statistics do not prove object semantics/content quality.
name: dataset manifest

constraints: Entity/activity/agent roles and qualified relations follow the selected provenance profile.
definition: A graph of entities, activities, agents and qualified derivation/responsibility relations.
information_loss_risks: Profile conversion may lose qualification, bundles or account/authority scope.
invalid_operations: Provenance path must not be interpreted as proof of correctness, authority or complete causality.
name: provenance graph

constraints: Job/run/dataset identities, input/output direction and event facets resolve.
definition: A run-oriented lineage graph connecting job/run identities to input/output dataset versions and facets.
information_loss_risks: Instrumentation gaps, dynamic access and name-based dataset identity make lineage incomplete.
invalid_operations: Reported lineage does not prove all reads/writes or column-level semantics.
name: lineage run graph

constraints: Every claim links to evidence/method, provenance, integrity and scope/limitations.
Contradicting evidence and defeaters can be represented.
definition: A manifested package of claims, supporting/contradicting evidence, methods, provenance, integrity and review status.
information_loss_risks: External references may rot; redaction may break verification; summaries may omit defeaters.
invalid_operations: Integrity, signature or approval must not be interpreted as truth by itself.
name: evidence bundle

constraints: Relation polarity/type and author/authority are explicit.
Cycles/conflicts are represented rather than silently resolved.
definition: A directed argument graph relating claims, supporting/opposing evidence, warrants, assumptions and defeaters.
information_loss_risks: Flattening to a confidence score loses reasons, defeaters and authority distinctions.
invalid_operations: Graph connectivity or vote count is not a truth calculus without an adjudication policy.
name: claim evidence graph

constraints: Contract identity/edition, owner, semantic types, constraints and compatibility relation are explicit.
definition: A versioned contract defining fields/types/shapes, semantic ownership, constraints, compatibility and service/quality obligations.
information_loss_risks: Format-specific mappings may omit laws, governance, time or quality obligations.
invalid_operations: Syntactic compatibility cannot stand in for semantic compatibility.
name: schema contract

constraints: Entry identity/sequence, integrity relation, authority and correction/reversal links are explicit.
definition: An append-preserving ordered collection of entries linked by sequence, integrity and authority, with explicit correction/reversal semantics.
information_loss_risks: Compaction, redaction and key loss may make verification or replay incomplete.
invalid_operations: Physical immutability is not proof of correctness; deletion/overwrite is invalid under ledger contract.
name: immutable ledger

constraints: Media type, transfer encoding, parameter decoding and recursion/resource limits are explicit.
definition: A recursively typed MIME entity consisting of content metadata and either encoded content or child entities.
information_loss_risks: Decoder variance, malformed boundaries and unsupported transfer encodings can change accessible content.
invalid_operations: Content-Type alone must not authorize rendering or execution.
name: mime entity

constraints: Boundary syntax is valid and child ordering/subtype semantics are preserved.
definition: An ordered MIME composite whose subtype defines how child entities relate, such as mixed, alternative, parallel or digest.
information_loss_risks: Flattening loses alternative/related/digest semantics and part identity.
invalid_operations: Selecting one alternative or flattening nested multipart without a declared policy is invalid.
name: mime multipart

constraints: Header syntax, line limits, address syntax, obsolete-form policy and body decoding are profiled.
definition: An Internet Message Format artifact with an ordered header-field section and optional body, distinct from its transport envelope or mailbox state.
information_loss_risks: Unfolding, transcoding and canonicalization alter bytes; repeated fields and obsolete syntax may be mishandled.
invalid_operations: Header order, Date, Message-ID or From must not be treated as authenticated transport truth without evidence.
name: internet message

constraints: Message identity, immutable content identity and mutable mailbox/keyword state are distinguished.
definition: A stored electronic-mail message binding an Internet message/MIME tree to account-scoped mailbox, keyword and delivery metadata.
information_loss_risks: Provider normalization, attachment extraction and mutable flags can be lost during export.
invalid_operations: Message-ID equality or identical subject must not prove duplicate content or conversation membership.
name: email message

constraints: Parent relation is acyclic and membership/cardinality rules are explicit.
definition: An account-scoped, possibly hierarchical collection that classifies stored emails without owning message content identity.
information_loss_risks: Labels, folders and multi-mailbox membership do not round-trip across all providers.
invalid_operations: Mailbox hierarchy must not be interpreted as a business taxonomy without an explicit mapping.
name: mailbox collection

constraints: Thread algorithm/profile, membership evidence and tie-breaking order are explicit.
definition: A profile-defined grouping/order of message artifacts or stored emails, carrying evidence and confidence for membership rather than universal conversation truth.
information_loss_risks: Provider-specific threading may merge unrelated messages or split one conversation.
invalid_operations: Subject similarity or reply-reference connectivity alone must not establish human conversational intent.
name: conversation thread

constraints: Page boxes, coordinate systems, logical structure, fonts and embedded-object policy are declared.
definition: A document represented as an ordered sequence of pages with positioned marks, optional logical structure and interactive objects.
information_loss_risks: Text extraction, font substitution, clipping, forms and scripts can make rendered and logical content diverge.
invalid_operations: Geometric order must not be assumed to be logical reading order.
name: paginated document

constraints: PDF edition/profile, encryption, signatures, embedded files, scripts and resource budgets are explicit.
definition: A PDF artifact preserving page graphics, objects, cross-references and optional logical structure under a pinned edition/profile.
information_loss_risks: Incremental updates, object streams, font encoding, OCR and redaction can hide or alter accessible content.
invalid_operations: Successful parsing/rendering must not imply safe content, correct reading order or trustworthy signature.
name: pdf document

constraints: Package edition, conformance class, part/relationship integrity, external links, formulas and active-content policy are explicit.
definition: A compound ZIP/XML office artifact containing parts, relationships, styles, formulas, media and optional active/external content.
information_loss_risks: Application-specific behavior, unsupported extensions and external resources may not round-trip.
invalid_operations: ZIP validity or XML schema validity must not authorize macros, links or embedded objects.
name: office document package

constraints: Style cascade, revision visibility, field evaluation and embedded-resource policy are explicit.
definition: A reflowable structured document of paragraphs, runs, sections, styles, fields, revisions, notes and embedded resources.
information_loss_risks: Track changes, comments, fields, layout and application extensions may be lost on conversion.
invalid_operations: Visible text, accepted text, stored revisions and extracted plain text must not be conflated.
name: word processing document

constraints: Cell value/formula duality, calculation mode, locale, date system, hidden content, external links and error values are explicit.
definition: A workbook graph containing sheets, cells, formulas, named ranges, tables, charts, links and calculation settings.
information_loss_risks: Formula dialects, date epochs, floating behavior, macros and external links can change results.
invalid_operations: A numeric cell must not be inferred to be a measure, and cached value must not replace formula semantics.
name: spreadsheet workbook

constraints: Master/theme inheritance, z-order, animation timing, notes and external/embedded media are explicit.
definition: An ordered slide/show artifact containing visual objects, notes, masters, timing, transitions and embedded media.
information_loss_risks: Font/media substitution, transitions, speaker notes and animations may be lost on conversion.
invalid_operations: Slide order or extracted text must not stand in for visual, animation or presenter-note semantics.
name: presentation document

constraints: Parser edition, base URL, character encoding, scripting, fetch and shadow/embedded content policies are explicit.
definition: An HTML document parsed to a DOM with linked/embedded resources and optional executable/interactive behavior.
information_loss_risks: Scripts, network resources, browser state, CSS and parser recovery make rendering time/context dependent.
invalid_operations: Serialized HTML, live DOM, rendered pixels and captured page must not be treated as identical.
name: html document

constraints: Manifest, spine, fallback, accessibility, scripting and remote-resource policies are explicit.
definition: A packaged digital publication with manifest, spine, navigation, content resources and fixed/reflowable layout controls.
information_loss_risks: Reading-system support, scripts, fonts, fixed layout and foreign resources affect presentation.
invalid_operations: ZIP order or manifest presence must not replace spine/navigation/reading-system semantics.
name: epub publication

constraints: Grammar/schema edition, tag/type resolution, duplicate-key, merge/alias and secret/reference policy are explicit.
definition: A grammar/schema-bound declaration of names and values intended to parameterize a separate system, without itself proving effect or authority.
information_loss_risks: Implicit typing, duplicate keys, aliases, environment interpolation and comments may not round-trip.
invalid_operations: Key name, string pattern or file location must not infer authority, secrecy or runtime effect.
name: configuration document

constraints: Language/edition, encoding, generated status, conditional compilation and dependency/build context are explicit.
definition: A text or binary source artifact interpreted under a named language grammar, edition, feature set and build context.
information_loss_risks: Comments, macros, generated regions, conditional compilation and environment dependencies affect meaning.
invalid_operations: Text equality or successful parsing must not imply behavioral equivalence, safety or build reproducibility.
name: source code file

constraints: Path normalization, symlink/submodule/generated-file and case-sensitivity policies are explicit.
definition: A versioned rooted tree of source, configuration, resource and generated artifacts plus declared dependency/build relationships.
information_loss_risks: Symlinks, submodules, ignored/generated content and executable bits may be lost in export.
invalid_operations: Filesystem path must not be treated as module identity or trusted import boundary without a language/build contract.
name: source tree

constraints: Grammar edition, recovery nodes, trivia preservation and source mapping are explicit.
definition: A language-edition-bound tree of syntax nodes, tokens and source spans, distinct from source text and typed semantic IR.
information_loss_risks: Desugaring, comments/trivia, error recovery and macro expansion may be absent or normalized.
invalid_operations: AST equality must not be inferred to imply runtime behavioral equivalence.
name: abstract syntax tree

constraints: Tool/rule/configuration/artifact editions and baseline/suppression semantics are explicit.
definition: A structured set of tool-run assertions linking rules, results, locations, artifacts and provenance.
information_loss_risks: Location drift, fingerprint collision, tool version and incomplete analysis can alter deduplication and results.
invalid_operations: Finding presence must not be treated as adjudicated defect or exploitability; absence is not proof of safety.
name: static analysis report

constraints: Object format, target architecture, ABI, relocation and symbol visibility are explicit.
definition: A relocatable or partially linked machine-code object with sections, symbols, relocations and target ABI requirements.
information_loss_risks: Stripped metadata, link-time optimization and producer extensions can impede reconstruction.
invalid_operations: Parseability or symbol presence must not imply safe behavior or ABI compatibility.
name: compiled object

constraints: Format, target, loader/ABI, imports, privileges, signatures and integrity scope are explicit.
definition: A loadable executable artifact whose bytes bind code/data, imports, resources, target ABI and optional signatures.
information_loss_risks: Packing, dynamic linking, self-modification, resources and environment-dependent behavior limit static interpretation.
invalid_operations: Digest/signature/format validity must not imply publisher authority, safe behavior or runtime compatibility.
name: executable binary

constraints: Bytecode edition/features, validation, imports, limits and embedding interface are explicit.
definition: A validated portable virtual-instruction module with types, functions, imports, exports, memories and declared embedding requirements.
information_loss_risks: Host imports, feature proposals, floating/nondeterministic host behavior and optimization affect execution.
invalid_operations: Core validation must not imply application safety or availability of embedding capabilities.
name: bytecode module

constraints: Member naming, path normalization, links, compression, encryption, integrity and expansion/resource bounds are explicit.
definition: A finite container of named members and metadata, optionally compressed/encrypted, whose safe extraction requires an explicit path/resource policy.
information_loss_risks: Path traversal, symlinks, duplicate names, bombs, filename encodings and unsupported encryption cause loss or harm.
invalid_operations: Member path must not become a filesystem path without confinement; checksum does not make content safe.
name: archive

constraints: Path separator, normalization, case, link, permission, timestamp and special-file policies are explicit.
definition: A rooted hierarchy of path entries, file payloads, links and metadata under declared filesystem naming and identity rules.
information_loss_risks: Links, special files, permissions, ACLs, sparse extents and timestamps may not round-trip.
invalid_operations: Path spelling must not imply portable identity, containment or case-insensitive equality.
name: file tree

constraints: Record type, target URI, capture time, payload digest, revisit and segment relations are explicit.
definition: An append-oriented sequence of web capture records linking requests, responses, resources, metadata, revisits and transformations.
information_loss_risks: Dynamic/client state, network dependencies, crawl scope and replay rewriting make captures incomplete.
invalid_operations: Captured response must not be treated as current, complete, authoritative or necessarily rendered page truth.
name: web archive

constraints: Ecosystem, namespace, version, platform/features, dependency ranges, payload digests and authority are explicit.
definition: A distributed artifact graph binding package metadata, payload members, dependency claims, platform constraints, integrity and provenance.
information_loss_risks: Dependency resolution, install scripts, native code and mutable registries compromise repeatability.
invalid_operations: Version syntax, registry presence or signature must not imply compatibility, trust or reproducible behavior.
name: software package

constraints: Media types, digest algorithms, platform, layer application, whiteouts and runtime configuration are explicit.
definition: A content-addressed OCI artifact graph with manifest/index, ordered filesystem layers and execution configuration.
information_loss_risks: Mutable tags, foreign layers, platform variance and runtime/environment differences limit equivalence.
invalid_operations: Content addressability must not imply publisher trust, vulnerability absence or runtime portability.
name: container image

constraints: CRS, extent, tile matrix, level, row/column origin, edge inclusion and resolution are explicit.
definition: A bounded spatial or image partition indexed under a declared tile matrix/level, CRS and edge/overlap convention.
information_loss_risks: Boundary clipping, simplification, quantization and reprojection can duplicate or split features/cells.
invalid_operations: Tile adjacency or index must not imply topological continuity or feature identity.
name: spatial tile

constraints: Matrix set, level resolutions, coverage extent, missing-tile semantics and version/frontier are explicit.
definition: A multiresolution collection of tiles governed by one or more tile matrices, layers, extents and completeness rules.
information_loss_risks: Mixed editions, overviews and independently regenerated tiles can break consistency.
invalid_operations: Missing tile must not be interpreted as an all-zero or empty spatial region without a contract.
name: spatial tile set

constraints: Framing/delimiter, escaping, schema editions, maximum record size and corruption recovery are explicit.
definition: A finite or appendable byte artifact containing a sequence of framed or delimited records under explicit framing, schema and corruption recovery rules.
information_loss_risks: Partial writes, delimiter ambiguity, schema changes and error recovery can shift record boundaries.
invalid_operations: Byte/file order must not be treated as event-time or causal order without a declared law.
name: record stream file
